facts.value: Form sheet of the application (Formular_01). Note: Only fully completed applications can be processed.
A written declaration stating whether there is an ongoing doctoral procedure elsewhere or whether previous doctoral projects have been unsuccessful.
A supervision agreement signed by the supervising person and the doctoral candidate (Formular_03).
Certified copy of the degree certificate (Magister, Diploma, Master, etc.). The certification can be performed by the doctoral office based on the original and copy of the certificates.

Certified copies of the required language proficiencies (Abiturzeugnis, Sprachdiploma, etc.). The certification can be performed by the doctoral office based on the original and copy of the certificates.
For applicants with foreign university degrees, the certificates must be verified for doctoral eligibility by the International Office or, if necessary, by the Central Office for Foreign Education.
This verification process (approximately 6-8 weeks) must be taken into account when planning the application.
A curriculum vitae must also be submitted.
